body.name: \(\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G),\Theta_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)\)
body.construction:
Define the two coefficient projections directly from mechanisms by
\[
 \Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)=
 \left\{\widetilde B:
 (\widetilde P,\widetilde B,\widetilde\varepsilon,
 \widetilde\pi)\in\mathfrak F_G(\mathcal O_G)
 \text{ for some }\widetilde P,\widetilde\varepsilon,
 \widetilde\pi\right\},
 \qquad N_{\mathrm{out}}=|\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)|,
\]
and
\[
 \Theta_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)=
 \left\{\widetilde B:
 (\widetilde P,\widetilde B,\widetilde\varepsilon,
 \widetilde\Gamma,\widetilde\pi)
 \in\mathfrak F_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)
 \text{ for some }\widetilde P,\widetilde\varepsilon,
 \widetilde\Gamma,\widetilde\pi\right\},
 \qquad
 N_{\mathrm{out}}^{\mathrm{CA}}
 =|\Theta_G^{\mathrm{CA}}(\mathcal O_G)|.
\]
Set braces remove numerical duplicates in both projections.
